column1: # rider. The value unifies exactly as v, and each record r rides the
# result through meets, reference copies and spread applications. A
# record's keys are the annotation keys -- title, description, comment,
# default, examples, readOnly, writeOnly, format, contentEncoding,
# contentMediaType and contentSchema, and x for the keywords JSON Schema
# does not name -- each holding concrete data of its kind; anything else
# refuses with func_arg. Two records meet as their key-wise union of
# canon-sorted value sets, so the meet is commutative and idempotent and
# never refuses. Every expectation is both engines' agreed answer.
# Canon renders the call back reparseably and outermost, after
# deprecate(); each record holds every key's next value.
# The meet unions the records, in either order and any number of times.
# A record rides a reference copy, a spread application and a conjunct,
# and the document renders its root's.
# A disjunction renders each member's record. A failing member's record
# goes with it, and a member dropped as another's duplicate leaves its
# record on the survivor, at every depth, so the join is order-free too.
# A trial schema keeps its record: the atom renders it, and the value
# the trial admits takes none, since a trial adds nothing to the value.

column3: a: when(meta({x: any}, {title: "c"}), meta({y: any}, {title: "t"}), meta({z: any}, {title: "e"}))

column1: # Generation is unchanged: a record never reaches the output.
# The value and at least one record; each record a map of annotation
# keys holding concrete data of the key's kind. The value refuses as
# vet and subsume read through the record.
# Export: the first record inline and any other in an allOf of
# annotation-only subschemas; x's members inline, where one naming a
# JSON Schema keyword is a reported loss, since it would assert.

column3: a: meta(string, {comment: "c", default: "x", examples: ["x"], readOnly: true, writeOnly: false, format: "email", contentEncoding: "base64", contentMediaType: "text/plain", contentSchema: {type: "string"}})

column4: {"lossy":[{"construct":"meta","path":"$.a","reason":"the unknown keyword type is a JSON Schema keyword, which would assert where the record only annotates, so it is DROPPED"}],"schema":{"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","properties":{"a":{"type":"number","x-ok":1}},"required":["a"],"type":"object"},"verdict":"lossy"}
